findings.why: Core's committed hi word for a record's description is विवरण (tui.authoring.description_clear_unsupported: 'मौजूदा विवरण'); core's only use of वर्णन is narration (wire.settings.display_narration.label: 'टर्न के दौरान वर्णन'). In this sheet that split is also visible on one screen: the title is 'विवरण संपादित करें' while the field beside नाम would read वर्णन. वर्णन ('narration/portrayal') is a literary label for a file's description field in a form; विवरण is the standard UI term and core's choice. Meaning is not lost by the current word — the defect is cross-surface term divergence, which the brief classes MAJOR.
findings.verified: bounded grep over core hi catalogues in audit.log + tools/verify-repl.ts render

findings.current: यह फ़ाइल ले जाई गई है या हटा दी गई है। इसका नाम, टैग और वर्णन अब भी यहाँ हैं।

findings.why: Same root as libb-hi-1: the sentence names the fields the editor labels, so वर्णन must follow the field label विवरण. One word changes; both sentences and both dandas (।) are otherwise correct, and the warning stays a warning (it implies no recovery).

Same defect as libb-ur-1: core's server tag grammar ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,23}$ refuses Devanagari tag names (probe in audit.log: «विषय-नाम» TagRefused, 'topic-name' created), so the example teaches a tag the field cannot save. `mobile.library.editor.new_tag_placeholder` must be added to `IDENTICAL_BY_DESIGN.<locale>` in src/i18n/__tests__/catalogues.test.ts with a reason, because the 'no shipped value equals English' test (catalogues.test.ts:281-286) fails on a value identical to en. A different ASCII example (e.g. `weekly-notes`) needs no allowlist entry. Same defect in ru, vi and zh-CN (probed); not my bundles.
findings.verified: tools/tagprobe.py (function gate + real MetadataStore.create_tag) + tools/verify-repl.ts render

findings.why: Core ships this confirmation as «बदलाव छोड़ें?» (tui.authoring.discard, tui.team_authoring.discard). छोड़ दें? is grammatical and polite but adds a 'go ahead and' softener to a destructive title; aligning costs one word and keeps the confirm-dialog wording identical across desktop and phone. Not unsafe — the destructive button is a separate string.
findings.verified: bounded grep over core hi catalogues in audit.log + render

findings.why: Core hi ships three spellings of this verb — ताज़ा करें (tui.review.hint_refresh), रीफ़्रेश (relay.notifications.error.refresh), रिफ़्रेश (wire.errors.desktop.refresh_requires_live) — so the current value is not a glossary violation; it matches the relay family. Flagging the split for the programme to settle rather than a defect of this string: ताज़ा करें is the Hindi term core uses for a refresh control, रीफ़्रेश the loan the relay uses.
findings.verified: bounded grep over core hi catalogues in audit.log
